verdict.rationale: Parahelp is a SaaS support-automation platform, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for this kind of product and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server. The API ('run it from your own tools via the API') and tool connections are adjacent capabilities and do not count as an official MCP server for connecting external agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
